feature: Build 42: root-caused and fixed the Rive holder disappearing-card bug, real carousel grow/exit transition, storefront text/banner/tab simplification
changesThisRound: Rive holder disappearing-card bug: root-caused via direct C++ parsing of the .riv file's actual keyframe/state-machine data (not guesswork). The artboard's own authored timeline settles its reveal (position/rotation/scale converge) by ~0.48s, then spends the rest of its ~3.5s runtime on a decorative tail that ends by fading the whole card to invisible between ~3.15s-3.5s. The old completion signal (state machine 'in'->'Idle' cycle) only fired at that full ~3.5s mark -- after the fade already played -- so the card always looked broken/vanished by the time anything treated it as 'done'. GachaRivePlaybackCoordinator now takes a settleHoldSeconds parameter and freezes the magnetic-holder layers ~0.55s after triggering playback, catching the fully-revealed frame before the fade-out runs. VERIFIED via real frame captures at three separate timestamps (t+~4.5s, +7.5s, +8.5s after the holder first appears) showing the identical, fully-visible card each time -- it no longer disappears.

Pack-tier carousel confirm now has a real choreographed exit: tapping 'select <tier>' grows the selected pack in place while the header text and unselected packs fade/slide away, then hands off to the real draw after ~0.46s -- confirmed via real frame capture showing the pack visibly larger and centered with the confirm/cancel UI gone, versus an instant cross-fade before.
Storefront header/subtitle/runtime-mode descriptive text removed; wallet chips are icon+number only (e.g. ticket icon + infinity symbol, gear icon + 0).

The stretched/over-cropped product-photo banner replaced with the app's own GachaPackVisual pack artwork (fixed 384:512 aspect, always scaledToFit) plus the real series name -- confirmed via frame capture, no distortion.

The two tab buttons ('抽取'/'收藏') now use real Liquid Glass (.productGlass, .glassEffect on this iOS 26.4 simulator) visually distinct from the solid-white primary CTA below, addressing a hierarchy complaint.
Added an explicit hard-rule callout to Docs/LiquidGlassDesignGuideline.md banning non-proportional image stretching, citing this incident.
knownRemainingItems: Rive de-branding (the yellow 'whatnot' bar) is NOT re-applied in this build -- it was reverted to the original branded asset last round after a flawed first patch, and the corrected v2 patch has not yet been re-integrated on top of this round's changes. The card in this video shows the original branded artwork.

The Rive entrance motion still cannot be literally anchored to the exact on-screen pack-tear position -- confirmed via the same investigation that no position/offset data-bind property exists in this asset; the SwiftUI-level rise animation was retimed (0.58s -> 0.5s) to better sync with the newly-measured ~0.48s internal settle point, which is the closest available approximation.
